scope: Independent CSV/actual PNG statistics, quality and compute audit; no attack/report module imports and no model execution
exact_methods: Python seeded paired image bootstrap + NumPy quantiles; SciPy exact binomial and beta-quantile CP bounds
limitations: LPIPS is not rerun; this audit checks saved-PNG evaluator values and records.
This script performs no parameter or output selection from formal validation outcomes.
Secondary comparisons are descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims.
FPR and the fixed joint clean cohort must accompany any robustness claim.
